def policy(obs, P):
    x = obs[0]
    v = obs[1]
    ang = obs[2]
    angv = obs[3]
    if x <= P['x_low']:
        return 1
    if ang >= P['ang_high']:
        return 1
    score = P['w_x']*x + P['w_v']*v + P['w_a']*ang + P['w_av']*angv + P['b']
    return 1 if score > 0 else 0
